title: 增长达标：反而不急刺激，内需软肋被掩盖
speaker: Erica Tay

segments.en: So David I think it's a relief. The growth numbers did not come out as weak as we feared.
segments.zh: 大卫，我认为这是一种宽慰。增长数据并没有我们担心的那么弱。

segments.en: But that also means that it reduces the urgency for policy makers
segments.zh: 但这也意味着降低了政策制定者的紧迫性

segments.en: To roll out any kind of massive economic stimulus in the next few months in order to meet the growth target
segments.zh: 在未来几个月推出大规模经济刺激以实现增长目标

segments.en: So I think overall the economy is still in a two-speed mode. So you see a external demand very strong
segments.zh: 所以我认为整体经济仍处于双速模式。外部需求非常强劲

segments.en: NGDP growth was undoubtedly supported by very strong net export numbers
segments.zh: 名义GDP增长无疑受到非常强劲的净出口数字支撑

segments.en: But beneath that a domestic demand engines are still going quite soft
segments.zh: 但在其之下，内需引擎仍然相当疲软

segments.en: So we see a retail sales showing signs of improvement. But still you know not quite as strongly as desired
segments.zh: 我们看到零售销售显示出改善迹象。但仍不如期望的那么强劲

segments.en: And investment is still quite soft. So I think all that suggests that I'm going forward
segments.zh: 而配置仍然相当疲软。所以我认为所有这些都表明，展望未来

segments.en: What would policy makers do next we don't quite know so it all depends on what their policy reaction function is
segments.zh: 政策制定者下一步会做什么我们不太清楚，所以这取决于他们的政策反应函数

segments.en: So if they respond the most to GDP numbers. It doesn't look quite so concerning
segments.zh: 所以如果他们主要对GDP数字做出反应，那看起来并不那么令人担忧

segments.en: But you know if what concerns them is a domestic demand indicators. I think that would be more reason to jump into action
segments.zh: 但你知道，如果他们担心的是内需指标，我认为那将是更有理由采取行动
